title: Shaida Mai Tsayayye
intro: Wani labari mai zurfi ya bayyana, yana bayyana jajircewar al'umma mai ƙarfi a gaban zalunci mai girma. Labarinsu yana aiki a matsayin shaida ga imani, koda lokacin da aka fuskanci babban sadaukarwa. Wannan labarin yana tunatar da mu ikon imani akan zalunci mai yawa.
clues: Mu ƙungiya ce da aka ba da labarinta a cikin wata gajeriyar sura mai ƙarfi, tana gargaɗi game da tsanantawa.
Mun fuskanci wani shugaba wanda yake son kawar da imaninmu ga Allah ɗaya tilo, Ubangijin Al'arshi, Abin godiya.
Mun fuskanci mummunan gwaji da ya shafi wani babban rami da aka haƙa a cikin ƙasa.
Mun kalli yadda aka jefa masu bi, har da jarirai, cikin wata mummunar gobara a cikin wannan ramin.
An la'anci masu azabtar da mu saboda ayyukansu, yayin da aka yi mana alƙawarin lada mai yawa saboda juriyarmu.
Yunkurin mai mulki na kashe imaninmu ya ƙarfafa matsayinmu a matsayin shahidai a gaban Allah, wanda yake shaida ga komai.

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An cece su ta hanyar mu'ujiza
An warwatse a ƙasashe da dama
An ba su dukiya mai yawa

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
